packageRules.description: Tauri 2 requires the GTK 0.18 native-link and type family.
sha2 0.11 removes the LowerHex implementation used for artifact revisions.
hmac and hkdf 0.13 need digest 0.11, which the sha2 hold above keeps out.
Huddle audio passes WebSocket streams to buzz-audio-client, so tokio-tungstenite must match the version it uses.
secp256k1 0.32+ changes signing and key APIs, and pairing must match nostr's version, so it gets its own PR.
Pairing passes nostr's keys to secp256k1 directly, so it stays on the 0.30 that nostr 0.45 links.
mesh-llm's log store requires rusqlite 0.40, and only one libsqlite3-sys may link sqlite3.
mdast-util-to-markdown 2.2 drops the attentionEncodeSurroundingInfo state the composer's strikethrough serializer sets.
Upgrade virtua only with a reviewed port of its WebKit scroll patch.
Biome minor releases change formatting and lint results across the tree, so each gets its own PR.
Update packageManager together with the Hermit pnpm pin in bin/.
